description: Thorsten Burandt publishes a stochastic version of GENeSYS-MOD, its application to the Japanese energy system and the underlying data. The native title identifies technology, demand and renewable data. Two ZIP descriptors distinguish the stochastic model package and Japan results; a PDF descriptor identifies a Japan dispatch-model document. These components are retained together as one study-specific data and model bundle for energy-system planning. Zenodo provides free access under the Apache 2.0 licence stated for the deposit. Coverage is Japan. The description does not specify the scenario horizon, geographical disaggregation, uncertainty distributions or simulation time steps. The related GENeSYS-MOD family record describes the broader model. The model and data archives were not opened, so numerical results, internal data licences and execution requirements were not independently verified.
